additionalLogicalTechnicalResponsibiliti.identity: Tenant/week/ScheduleKey complete captured source/recipient manifest and stable technical pagination; exact existing effect identities are preserved.
additionalLogicalTechnicalResponsibiliti.owns: Durable capture before effects, original zero/partial-page response, resumable deterministic per-recipient WeeklyWorkDigest admissions and complete source-cut provenance.
additionalLogicalTechnicalResponsibiliti.physicalPlacement: Separate logical capture/page-result responsibility. Exact physical native-journal or versioned-CAS placement is not selected here; no forced KV rewrite. Per-recipient delivery/unknown-outcome journals remain independently identified.
additionalLogicalTechnicalResponsibiliti.authority: Root-directed existing schedule placement correction; technical command/result ownership only.

logicalIdentity.rule: Pages address one captured complete source/recipient manifest; no new business owner per page.

joinRules: Use exact selected event ownership before an earlier split-parent label.
canonicalOwner=null is deliberate: typed union, split allocation, transient rules or logical technical process; never pick the first child.
Technical native-journal/emitter placement and business authority are separate; do not force a KV rewrite.
Projection/legacy aliasing is semantic classification, not authorization to re-emit/convert stored facts or reuse old identities.

excludedFromCanonicalAliasJoin.rule: These classifications remain in full evidence only; they are not canonical business/technical alias join candidates.

identityReadingRule: Selected identities preserve exact occupied algorithms and selected typed signature bindings; old baseline RequestId/server-clock/replay observations are evidence only. Full signature/source pointers are in canonical-owner-map.json.
